text: The phages infected the bacteria. Then a kitchen blender shook the empty coats off, and a centrifuge spun the heavy bacteria into a pellet. The phosphorus was inside the bacteria, and in the next generation of phages. The sulphur stayed outside, in the liquid. Only DNA had entered the cell. DNA is the genetic material.
